# pve_node_apt_update (Action)

Resynchronizes the package index files of one node from their sources (`apt-get update`, `POST /nodes/{node}/apt/update`) and waits for the task to finish. The action updates the package index only; upgrading installed packages remains an out-of-band task.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Refresh the package index of node pve1 (apt-get update) and wait for the
# task to finish.
action "pve_node_apt_update" "refresh_pve1" {
  config {
    node  = "pve1"
    quiet = true
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node whose package index to refresh.

### Optional

- `notify` (Boolean) Send a notification about new packages. Defaults to `false`.
- `quiet` (Boolean) Only produce output suitable for logging, omitting progress indicators. Defaults to `false`.
